title: kithctl backup: pre-create-0o600 + CleanupGuard pattern is correct for secure backup
description: backup.rs pre-creates the destination file with mode 0o600 before SQLite opens it, avoiding the umask-0o644 race window. CleanupGuard provides RAII cleanup on failure. A contributor might suggest just using SQLite's Connection::open directly; that would expose the backup file as world-readable until the backup completes. This pattern is worth preserving and documenting.
